compatibilityPolicy.breakingChangeRule: Publish a new major contract version and retain the previous schema for historical validation.
compatibilityPolicy.enumExpansionRule: Treat enum expansion as breaking for strict consumers; publish a new major contract version.
compatibilityPolicy.additionalPropertiesRule: Schemas currently using additionalProperties=false reject unknown fields. Additive fields are not assumed backward-compatible; validate against an explicitly selected contract version.
compatibilityPolicy.migrationRule: No implicit migration. Every migration must identify source and target versions, be deterministic, preserve evidence provenance, and include round-trip or documented-loss tests.
compatibilityPolicy.unknownVersionRule: Reject unknown contract versions; never silently coerce to the latest schema.

contracts.name: assessment-report
contracts.notes: Contains nested evidence metadata; its observationClass must remain aligned with evidence-record v1.

contracts.name: brand-truth-registry
contracts.notes: Owner-attested brand facts with source provenance and explicit corroboration state; the content digest is a checksum, not a signature or authenticity guarantee.

contracts.name: evidence-ledger-checkpoint
contracts.notes: Detached Ed25519 checkpoint; signature trust depends on out-of-band public-key custody.

contracts.name: evidence-ledger-entry
contracts.notes: Append-only logical ledger entry; local store limitations are documented separately.

contracts.name: evidence-legal-hold-event
contracts.notes: Signed place/release event for a fixed evidence scope. Signatures verify against a caller-trusted Ed25519 key or actor-bound approver registry; requester authentication, legal authority and durable journal/key-registry custody remain external.

contracts.name: evidence-legal-hold-journal-checkpoint
contracts.notes: Detached Ed25519 checkpoint of a journal prefix; store checkpoint and trusted checkpoint public key outside the journal trust domain.

contracts.name: evidence-legal-hold-journal-entry
contracts.notes: Hash-linked envelope around a signed legal-hold event; local persistence remains single-process and non-WORM.

contracts.name: evidence-record
contracts.notes: Version is carried by schema identity; record shape itself has no schemaVersion field.

contracts.name: evidence-redaction-journal-checkpoint
contracts.notes: Detached Ed25519 signature over a journal prefix; checkpoint and trusted public key must be held independently to detect suffix truncation or journal replacement.

contracts.name: evidence-redaction-journal-entry
contracts.notes: Hash-linked envelope for a signed redaction manifest; local journal integrity is not WORM or cross-process locking.

contracts.name: evidence-redaction-manifest
contracts.notes: Signed approval for logical suppression from exports; does not represent physical deletion or media sanitization.

contracts.name: geo-observation
contracts.notes: GEO observationClass is a strict subset of evidence-record v1.

contracts.name: geo-prompt-cohort
contracts.notes: Deterministic, locale-scoped prompt cohort pinned to a specific Brand Truth Registry content digest.

contracts.name: geo-sampling-plan
contracts.notes: Preflight sampling plan pinned to the exact registry revision, with explicit policy review, provider separation, manual consumer observation, official API-only model observations, per-provider sample caps and a hard estimated-cost ceiling. It does not execute collection.

contracts.name: mcp-snapshot
contracts.notes: Caller-supplied normalized MCP metadata snapshot; no network connection or tool invocation.
